title: [review] project-LICHEN-worker6-69p2: DEFAULT_WINDOW_SIZE=32 contradicts WINDOW_SIZE=63
description:
DEFAULT_WINDOW_SIZE was changed from 63 to 32 but WINDOW_SIZE remains 63. DEFAULT_WINDOW_SIZE is currently unused in production code (only referenced in std_ext test module where window_size is passed as parameter), making the constant misleading. If it's going to be used as a default for the std_ext FragmentReceiver, it should equal WINDOW_SIZE=63, not 32.

The constant DEFAULT_RECEIVER_LIMIT=1281 was also removed without replacement, and the fuzz harness switched to a local RECEIVER_STORAGE=16384 constant.

Affected: rust/lichen-schc/src/fragment.rs constants section
